modinfo.author: Tommy
modinfo.description: Sets all food shared cooldown to 10 seconds (10000ms) for 610 consumables (food, plus herbs, insects, holy water, elixirs and horse tonics). Vanilla is 1s. Built for Crimson Desert 2.03.02. Food cooldown based on CD Food Cooldown by Rogue69 (Nexus mod 3090). Field-name (V3) mod: DMM locates each field itself, so it survives game updates that move data.
modinfo.title: CD Food Cooldown 10s
